marlin_bay_unified_school_board_as_a_bod.name: Marlin Bay Unified school board (as a body)

scene.note: events declared visible to this actor are directly experienced

memories.content: The board has the proposal on its agenda for both September meetings. Two trustees are up for re-election in November. The board is aware that the proposal has been tabled twice and that a parent group plans to pack public comment.

The Marlin Bay Unified school board holds two meetings in September 2026. The later-start-times proposal is on the agenda for both meetings. The board can take a recorded vote at either meeting. The parent group has publicly stated they will pack the public-comment period.
